sources.entry: ShadowsocksX-NG - Next generation of ShadowsocksX. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/qiuyuzhou/ShadowsocksX-NG)

summary.one_liner: ShadowsocksX-NG2 is a native macOS menu bar Shadowsocks client for Apple Silicon Macs, with a separate app line from the legacy ShadowsocksX-NG 1.x releases.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a menu bar app that manages Shadowsocks server configurations, groups, and favorites, and can import configs or add HTTPS SIP-008 subscriptions showing traffic and expiry info. It offers global, rules, and direct routing modes, with bundled rules plus custom rules. It exposes local SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies, with optional LAN listeners (off by default) and access credentials. It bundles v2ray-plugin and Cloak, and v2ray-plugin also supports a Hysteria2 transport mode that must be matched on both ends. Local configuration is encrypted with age, and diagnostic exports omit passwords, plugin options, and subscription URLs. The README also states it can import legacy server configurations from 1.x.
use_cases: Manage multiple Shadowsocks servers from the Mac menu bar
Route selected sites through a proxy using custom rules
Share a proxy with other Mac apps or LAN devices
Import SIP-008 subscription feeds from a provider
Use v2ray-plugin or Cloak obfuscation with Shadowsocks
Migrate server configs from the legacy ShadowsocksX-NG
how_to_run: Check that the Mac runs macOS 15 or later on Apple Silicon (arm64)
Obtain a Shadowsocks server configuration or SIP-008 subscription URL from your provider
Download ShadowsocksX-NG2 from GitHub Releases once it is published
Open the app and add a server or subscription from the menu bar
notable: Native menu bar client with Simplified Chinese and English interfaces
SIP-008 subscription support with traffic and expiry display
Local SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy endpoints with optional LAN access and credentials
Encrypted local server library and privacy-conscious diagnostic exports
Can coexist with the legacy 1.x app and import its server configs
caveats: NG2 is not yet available for download according to the README; the Releases page currently hosts legacy 1.x releases
Requires macOS 15 or later and Apple Silicon; older or Intel Macs are not supported
Provides a client only; no servers or subscription services are included
Hysteria2 mode only works when both ends use it; ordinary Hysteria2 nodes are incompatible
macOS system proxy settings are shared with the legacy app, so only one should manage them at a time
